captions.detailed: A service-station manual floor pump featuring a tall, black tubular barrel, a flat base footplate, and a T-shaped handle at the top. Near the bottom, a rectangular gauge housing is mounted to the side, featuring a circular analog gauge on one face and a small red pressure-release button on the side. The handle and its metallic piston rod translate vertically along the pump axis, while the small red release button moves prismatically as a push control, and the gauge needle rotates on its local pivot.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a service-station floor pump. The pump should feature a black cylindrical barrel on a footplate, a top T-handle with a metallic piston rod, and a side-mounted gauge box near the base. Incorporate a prismatic joint for the handle translation, a prismatic joint for the red pressure-release button on the gauge box, and a continuous rotational joint for the gauge needle.
captions.factory: Construct the pump base and main cylindrical barrel using a combination of box and cylinder primitives. Model the T-handle as a horizontal cylinder with black grip cylinders, attached to a vertical piston rod cylinder. Create the side gauge housing using box primitives, adding a small cylinder for the red release button and a thin disk for the dial needle. Define three articulations: a prismatic joint along the Z-axis for the handle and piston rod, a prismatic joint along the Y-axis for the red button, and a continuous revolute joint around the X-axis for the gauge needle.
